maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly rent from leasing logistics warehouses it develops and owns, not repair or replacement of customers' installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Tenants are private logistics, retail, e-commerce and manufacturing companies paying warehouse rent; government is not the final payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through developing its own warehouses and leasing; it has made large mergers but not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Tenants running warehouses and distribution networks face relocation, downtime and fit-out costs if they leave strategically located facilities.
